_comment: Geolocation config for Saturation Status Dashboard. All India States, Districts, and Blocks with center coordinates and zoom levels.

boundary_sources._comment: GeoJSON boundary URLs for State and District levels. Block level uses local geoBoundaries-IND-ADM3.geojson served via get_boundary_geojson API.

name_aliases._comment: Maps the State/District names stored in Frappe to the spellings used by the boundary GeoJSON sources. The district layer is a pre-2014 GADM snapshot, so it still uses the older state names.

boundary_fields._comment: Property keys carrying the feature name and its parent, per boundary source.
